subproblem.title: Deformation Theorem 5.1 (unscaled) for IM T with IM ∂T vanishing off a compact set, with an explicit unit lattice chain
subproblem.statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure and R.action(β) = ∫_M θ ξ(β) dHᵈ for any d-form β; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set E if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from E. Assume (SL) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_slicing_lipschitz (the antecedent of the parent statement dor_lmb_fc_deformation), taken as an antecedent: assuming (C1) [for open U, X ∈ 𝒟_d(U) and an IMRep R in U representing X: M_W(X) = μ_R(W) for every open W and spt X = U ∩ spt μ_R], for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ), every IMRep RB = (M', θ', ξ') representing ∂T and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are P_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) such that (1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from f⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Assume (IMS) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_fc_im_series (a resolved dependency of the parent node, not yet accepted, hence taken as an antecedent): for all P, m, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM currents X_r ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (r ∈ ℕ) with Σ_r M(X_r) ≠ ∞ there is an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) with Σ_r X_r(ω) = Y(ω) (HasSum) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U) and M(Y) ≤ Σ_r M(X_r). Let P, m ∈ ℕ with n := m + 1 < P. There is c ≥ 0 such that for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and every IM T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with ∂T IM and T vanishing off K, there are a finite set s of pairs p = (z_p, ι_p) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P), integers β_p (a function β) and currents Pc ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P), S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that: ι_p is strictly increasing for p ∈ s; Pc(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι_p(0)}, …, e_{ι_p(m)}) dHⁿ(x) for every ω, where F_p := {x : z_{p,i} ≤ x_i ≤ z_{p,i} + 1 for i ∈ range ι_p, x_i = z_{p,i} otherwise} is the closed unit n-face of p = (z_p, ι_p) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P) (the cell latticeFace 1 p of the project's GMT/Ch06/Contract.lean), oriented by e_{ι_p(0)} ∧ ⋯ ∧ e_{ι_p(m)}, e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1; R and S are IM; T(ω) − Pc(ω) = ∂R(ω) + S(ω) for every ω; Σ_{p∈s}|β_p| ≤ c·M(T), M(R) ≤ c·M(T) and M(S) ≤ c·M(∂T) (in [0, ∞]); F_p ⊆ cthickening(2√P, K) for p ∈ s; and R and S vanish off cthickening(2√P, K).

∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X r)) → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (K) → T ω = 0) → ∃ (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (β : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → ℤ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Pc ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ x in {x : Euclid P | ∀ i : Fin P, (i ∈ Set.range p.2 → (p.1 i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ p.1 i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range p.2 → x i = p.1 i)}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ)) ∂μHE[m + 1]) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), T ω - Pc ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ (∑ p ∈ s, ((β p).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * T.boundary.mass ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, {x : Euclid P | ∀ i : Fin P, (i ∈ Set.range p.2 → (p.1 i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ p.1 i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ Set.range p.2 → x i = p.1 i)} ⊆ cthickening (2 * Real.sqrt P) K) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 2))) (cthickening (2 * Real.sqrt P) K) → R ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (cthickening (2 * Real.sqrt P) K) → S ω = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, Deformation Theorem 5.1 (unscaled) and the end of its printed proof, display (38) and the closing paragraph ("Setting R = R₁, S = S₁ + (Q − P), the theorem now follows …", chapter-06.txt), for IM T with IM ∂T vanishing off a compact K; this is steps 0, 8 and the unit-scale part of step 10 of the parent proof. Dependencies: SD = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_skeleton_deformation (displays (1)–(25)); FR = sibling dor_lmb_fcd_face_replacement (displays (26)–(37)); (C1) = reused sibling dor_imrep_massOn_eq_measure_and_support; (IMC) = reused sibling cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub; (SL), (IMS) = the antecedents of the statement, passed to SD.

Notation. n := m + 1 < P; all currents on univ; L_n := {x : at least P − n integer coordinates}; F_p the closed unit face of p = (z, ι) as in the statement; “X vanishes off E” as in the statement.

1. Constants. Let c_s ≥ 0 be SD's constant (for (SL), (IMS), P, m) and c_f ≥ 0 FR's constant (for P, m). Put c := c_s(1 + c_f) ≥ 0; it depends only on P and m.

2. Finiteness of masses (parent step 0). Let R_T = (M, θ, ξ) represent T. By (C1) (U = univ), M(T) = μ_{R_T}(ℝ^P), and μ_{R_T}(ℝ^P ∖ K) = M_{ℝ^P∖K}(T) = 0 because every admissible form for the open set ℝ^P ∖ K has tsupport disjoint from K, where T vanishes. Hence M(T) = μ_{R_T}(K) ≤ ∫_{M∩K}θ dHⁿ < ∞ by the local integrability field of the IMRep (K compact). ∂T is IM and vanishes off K (∂T(ω) = T(dω) and tsupport dω ⊆ tsupport ω), so the same argument gives M(∂T) < ∞.

3. Deformation onto the skeleton. SD applied to K and T (IM, ∂T IM, vanishing off K, finite masses) gives Q ∈ 𝒟_n, R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}, S₁ ∈ 𝒟_n, all IM, with T(ω) − Q(ω) = ∂R₁(ω) + S₁(ω) for all ω, M(Q) ≤ c_sM(T), M(∂Q) ≤ c_sM(∂T), M(R₁) ≤ c_sM(T), M(S₁) ≤ c_sM(∂T), Q vanishing off L_n ∩ K_Q with K_Q := cthickening(√P, K) (compact: IsCompact.cthickening), and R₁, S₁ vanishing off K_Q.

4. Face replacement. M(∂Q) ≤ c_sM(∂T) < ∞. FR applied to K_Q and Q gives s, β, Pc with: StrictMono p.2 for p ∈ s; Pc(ω) = Σ_{p∈s}β_p∫_{F_p}ω(x)(e_{ι_p}) dHⁿ(x) for all ω; Q − Pc IM; M(Q − Pc) ≤ c_fM(∂Q); Σ_{p∈s}|β_p| ≤ c_fM(Q); F_p ⊆ cthickening(√P, K_Q) for p ∈ s; Q − Pc vanishes off cthickening(√P, K_Q).

5. Theorem 5.1, display (38). Put R := R₁ and S := S₁ − ((Q − Q) − (Q − Pc)) (that is, S = S₁ + (Q − Pc) written with the contract subtraction). By (IMC)(c) (U = univ is open): Q − Q is IM (Q is IM), then (Q − Q) − (Q − Pc) is IM, then S is IM; R = R₁ is IM. For every ω, S(ω) = S₁(ω) − (0 − (Q(ω) − Pc(ω))) = S₁(ω) + Q(ω) − Pc(ω), hence
 T(ω) − Pc(ω) = (T(ω) − Q(ω)) + (Q(ω) − Pc(ω)) = ∂R₁(ω) + S₁(ω) + Q(ω) − Pc(ω) = ∂R(ω) + S(ω).

6. Masses. For any currents A, B of the same degree, M(A − B) ≤ M(A) + M(B): for an admissible ω, −ω is admissible, so ENNReal.ofReal(A(ω) − B(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(A(ω)) + ENNReal.ofReal(B(−ω)) ≤ M(A) + M(B); take the supremum. Also M(Q − Q) = 0 (Q − Q = 0). Therefore
 M(S) ≤ M(S₁) + M((Q − Q) − (Q − Pc)) ≤ M(S₁) + M(Q − Pc) ≤ c_sM(∂T) + c_fM(∂Q) ≤ (c_s + c_fc_s)M(∂T) = c·M(∂T);
 M(R) = M(R₁) ≤ c_sM(T) ≤ c·M(T);
 Σ_{p∈s}|β_p| ≤ c_fM(Q) ≤ c_fc_sM(T) ≤ c·M(T)
 (all in [0, ∞], with ENNReal.ofReal of the nonnegative constants).

7. Supports (parent step 10 at unit scale). cthickening(√P, cthickening(√P, K)) ⊆ cthickening(2√P, K) (Mathlib Metric.cthickening_cthickening_subset; √P + √P = 2√P). Hence F_p ⊆ cthickening(2√P, K) for p ∈ s. R = R₁ vanishes off K_Q ⊆ cthickening(2√P, K). If tsupport ω is disjoint from cthickening(2√P, K), then it is disjoint from K_Q and from cthickening(√P, K_Q), so S₁(ω) = 0, (Q − Pc)(ω) = 0 and (Q − Q)(ω) = 0, whence S(ω) = 0.

8. Conclusion. s, β, Pc, R, S satisfy every clause of the statement with the constant c of step 1. ∎
proof_key_steps: M(T), M(∂T) < ∞ by (C1) and local integrability of the IMReps on the compact K.
SD gives IM Q, R₁, S₁ with T − Q = ∂R₁ + S₁, Q carried by L_n ∩ cthickening(√P, K) and the mass bounds.
FR applied to Q gives the unit lattice chain Pc with Q − Pc IM, M(Q − Pc) ≤ c_f M(∂Q) and Σ|β| ≤ c_f M(Q).
(38): R := R₁, S := S₁ + (Q − Pc) (contract subtraction), IM by (IMC)(c); mass subadditivity gives the bounds with c = c_s(1 + c_f).
cthickening(√P, cthickening(√P, K)) ⊆ cthickening(2√P, K) gives the face and vanishing clauses.

audit.reason: The proof correctly derives finite masses, applies skeleton deformation and face replacement, and forms S using the contract subtraction. The constant c_s(1 + c_f) and successive thickenings establish every conclusion. An independent exact-type conditional Lean assembly confirms this implication.
